_comment: LOCKED docx geometry: page size, margins, fonts, tab stop and vertical spacing for the rendered CV. These numbers are what keeps every generated .docx identical in layout, so a tailored CV never drifts typographically from the last one. Change them deliberately and re-render an existing position to see the effect before you keep it.
_section_order_comment: Fixed in render_cv.py, not data-driven. A model cannot reorder these.
